# Grace Online Library

> A curated library of Reformed, Puritan, and confessionally Baptist theological articles — free for the church since 1999.

Grace Online Library is a theological resource site offering hundreds of articles from historic Reformed, Puritan, and confessionally Baptist authors. All content is free and intended to serve pastors, students, and serious Bible readers.

## What This Site Contains

- Theological articles on Reformed doctrine, Puritan spirituality, church history, apologetics, eschatology, and more
- Works by historic authors including John Calvin, John Owen, Charles Spurgeon, B.B. Warfield, Herman Bavinck, J.C. Ryle, and many others
- Articles organized by topic and author
- Content spanning the 16th–20th centuries of Protestant and Reformed Christianity

## Key Topics

Reformed Theology, Five Points of Calvinism (TULIP), Covenant Theology, Church History, Puritans, Sovereignty of God, Justification by Faith, Sanctification, Eschatology, Apologetics, The Atonement, Biographies of Reformed figures

## Site Structure

- `/` — Homepage with recent articles and topic categories
- `/articles` — Full article index
- `/[slug]` — Individual articles and topic category pages
- `/author/[slug]` — Author biography and article listings
- `/authors` — Full author index
- `/topics` — Full topic index
- `/about` — About the library
- `/sitemap.xml` — Full sitemap
- `/feed.xml` — RSS feed (50 most recent articles)

## Usage Guidelines

- Content may be used for training, summarization, and research purposes
- Please attribute articles to their original authors
- All content is in the public domain or used with permission for educational purposes
- Prefer `/sitemap.xml` for crawling all available URLs
- Prefer `/feed.xml` for recent content
